2607.05035.title: RUFNet: Query-Guided Support Mask Refinement and Uncertainty Fusion based on Hybrid Mamba for Few-Shot Brain Tumor Segmentation
2607.05035.paper_summary: Few-shot brain tumor segmentation remains challenging due to noisy support masks, inter-patient variations between support and query images, and the lack of pixel-wise confidence estimation. This study proposes RUFNet, a Hybrid Mamba-based few-shot framework that combines support mask refinement with uncertainty-aware posterior fusion. To preserve support-query dependencies with manageable cost, RUFNet adopts a Hybrid Mamba interaction backbone with linear complexity. To reduce support-mask noise, an Attention-Guided Mask Refinement module (AGMR) uses query features to recalibrate support masks and improve prototype consistency. To handle ambiguous predictions, an Uncertainty-Aware Posterior Fusion module (UAPF) estimates pixel-wise variance and adaptively balances few-shot predictions with query-aligned priors. On the Brain Tumor Segmentation Challenge (BraTS) 2020 dataset, RUFNet achieves Dice coefficients of 84.3% and 86.1% in the 1-way 1-shot and 1-way 5-shot settings, respectively, outperforming the compared state-of-the-art methods. These results suggest that Hybrid Mamba interaction, mask refinement and uncertainty modelling can improve the robustness of few-shot medical image segmentation. The official implementation code is available at https://github.com/hdy6438/RUFNet.
2607.05035.paper_summary_zh: 少樣本腦腫瘤分割仍然具有挑戰性，原因包括噪聲支持掩碼、支持圖像和查詢圖像之間的患者變異，以及缺乏逐像素的置信度估計。這項研究提出了RUFNet，一種基於Hybrid Mamba的少樣本框架，結合了支持掩碼的精煉和不確定性感知的後驗融合。為了以可管理的成本保留支持-查詢依賴性，RUFNet採用了具有線性複雜度的Hybrid Mamba交互骨幹。為了減少支持掩碼的噪聲，注意力引導的掩碼精煉模塊（AGMR）使用查詢特徵來重新校準支持掩碼並改善原型一致性。為了處理模糊的預測，不確定性感知的後驗融合模塊（UAPF）估計逐像素的方差，並自適應地平衡少樣本預測與查詢對齊的先驗。在2020年腦腫瘤分割挑戰賽（BraTS）數據集上，RUFNet在1-way 1-shot和1-way 5-shot設置中分別達到了84.3%和86.1%的Dice係數，超越了比較的最先進方法。這些結果表明，Hybrid Mamba交互、掩碼精煉和不確定性建模可以提高少樣本醫學影像分割的穩健性。官方實現代碼可在https://github.com/hdy6438/RUFNet獲得。
